除.meaning: A tour guide waves her <part>pennant</part> at the boat dock. Forty tourists, thirty seats: that's <part>too much</part>. She points the flag at the last ten in line and shakes her head. To fit on the boat, she has to <kanji>exclude</kanji> them.
除.on: One of them is a <sound>jo</sound>gger, who just runs along the bank beside the boat.
除.kun: '<sound>No</sound>!' cries a fortune-teller left on the dock, shaking her <sound>zo</sound>diac chart. She's removed anyway.

掃.meaning: A ship's cook ties a <part>feather duster</part> to the ship's <part>anchor</part> and drops it overboard. As the ship drifts, it drags along the seabed, brushing the sand off old coins and sleepy crabs. Swish, swish: he's found a way to <kanji>sweep</kanji> the ocean floor.
掃.on: Then he scrubs the deck with a bar of <sound>soa</sound>p until the foam spills over the side.
掃.kun: The duster bumps into a tiny <sound>hu</sound>t on the seabed and sweeps its doorstep too.

画.meaning: An octopus paints on the harbour wall: <part>one</part> long line for the sea, then a jar with a stem in the middle, for no <part>reason</part> at all. It dips each arm in a <part>bucket</part> of ink first. Eight arms, eight swishes, each one a perfect <kanji>brush-stroke</kanji>.
画.on: Then it paints a bulb of <sound>gar</sound>lic, so real that passing fish stop to sniff it.
画.kun: A <sound>ca</sound>rp swims up to look, and a <sound>coo</sound>k on the pier draws a chalk line round the painting: marked off.

司.meaning: On a film set, a bossy woman perches on a <part>crowbar</part> bent into a tall chair. From her <part>mouth</part> comes just <part>one</part> word, 'Action!', and a hundred people leap into motion. She's the <kanji>director</kanji>.
司.on: When the stunt goes wrong, she ducks behind a knight's <sound>shie</sound>ld from the props table.
司.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' she sneezes, then orders a <sound>ca</sound>rp, a <sound>sa</sound>rdine and a <sound>do</sound>lphin to their places: she rules the set.

寿.meaning: A tortoise turns a hundred and throws a party on the golf course. It swings its <part>golf club</part> beside a cake with <part>three</part> tiers, and one <part>slash</part> of the knife cuts the first slice. Here's to a hundred more: <kanji>longevity</kanji>!
寿.on: A <sound>ju</sound>ry of old turtles agrees it's the oldest guest they've ever seen.
寿.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala carves it a <sound>to</sound>tem pole, a friend gives it a <sound>boo</sound>k, and the mayor hands over a golden <sound>key</sound>.

科.meaning: In a big store, a sign hangs over one aisle: here everything is sold by the <part>ladle</part>. Shoppers scoop <part>grain</part>, oats, flour and lentils from tall barrels into paper bags. It's the bulk food <kanji>department</kanji>.
科.on: A <sound>ca</sound>rp in a tank by the till gobbles every grain that spills.
